opportunities.observation: The exact post-barrier M384 trace spends 1.488205758 s of summed kernel time across 900 extend-attention launches in 15 non-overlapping target-verification cycles. Both local and global subtypes use 255 registers/thread and materialize 64-row or 32-row query tiles although each c32 request contributes exactly 12 query rows.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Gemma 4 31B revision b9ea41a, SGLang 28b095c, H200 SXM, native NGRAM c32 depth-12 M384 target verification
competing_explanations: The 255-register attention kernels are dominated by useful KV traversal and a smaller query tile will only add launch overhead.
The trace-selected target cycles are not representative of the whole request because prefill and draining batches dominate service time.
The 20% ceiling is open only under counter-derived extrapolation and closes under a new whole-request capture.
opportunities.mechanism: Dispatch only exact c32 q_len=12 M384 target verification to an eight-row attention tile, reducing padded query rows and accumulator live state while retaining the stock kernel for every other shape.
opportunities.falsifier: Exact-consumer mismatch, missing candidate-path proof under CUDA graph replay, warm component regression, or a scope-matched critical-path bound below the retained-gain threshold.
opportunities.next_measurement: After DFlash releases, run one short whole-request capture, exact-consumer stock/candidate oracle, warm alternating component A/B, candidate-path/resource counters, and one endpoint pair only when the measured bound warrants it.
opportunities.intuition: At q_len=12 the stock Hopper tile keeps state for 2.7x to 5.3x more rows than are live; exact specialization can lower register pressure and useless score/value work without changing masks, positions, cache ownership, or semantics.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Retain any reproducible exact positive component and endpoint effect; claim the 20% objective only from the matched endpoint.
opportunities.kill_rule: Close this decomposition after one correct exact-shape candidate if component timing is negative or the corrected whole-request ceiling is closed.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: If attention improves, remeasure the non-overlapping target-forward union before considering FP8 projections; do not optimize mask, penalty, allocator, or LM-head symptoms.
